abbott_smith_html:
δόξα, -ης, ἡ
(δοκέω), [in LXX very frequently for כָּבוֹד, also for הוֹד ,פִּפְאֶרֶת, etc., 25 words in all ;]
in cl.,
__1. expectation, judgment, opinion (4Ma.5:18).
__2. opinion, estimation in which one is held, repute; in NT, always good opinion, hence reputation, praise, honour, glory: Luk.14:10, Jhn.12:43, Heb.3:3; opposite to αἰσχύνη, Php.3:19; to ἀτιμία, 2Co.6:8; δ. κ. τιμή, Rom.2:7, 10 1Pe.1:7, 2Pe.1:17; ζητεῖν, Jhn.5:44 7:18 8:50, 1Th.2:6; λαμβάνειν, Jhn.5:41, 2Pe.1:17, Rev.5:12; διδόναι δ. τ. θεῷ (cf. נָתַן כָּבוֹד לַיהוָֹה, Jer.13:16, al.), Luk.17:18, Jhn.9:24, Act.12:23, Rom.4:20, Rev.4:9; εἰς (τ.) δ. θεοῦ, Rom.3:7 15:7, Php.1:11, al.; in doxologies, τ. θεῷ (ᾧ) ἡ δ., Luk.2:14, Rom.11:36 16:27, Gal.1:5, Eph.3:21, al.
__3. Later also (not cl.) as in LXX (= הוֹד, Job.39:20, 1Ch.29:25; כָּבוֹד, Job.19:9, Est.5:11, al.), visible brightness, splendour, glory: of light, Act.22:11; of heavenly bodies, 1Co.15:40ff.; esp. that wh. radiates from God's presence, as manifested in the pillar of cloud and in the Holy of Holies (= כָּבוֹד, Exo.16:10 25:22 40:34, al.; and new Heb. שְׁכִינָה, 2Ma.2:8; see DB, iv, 489b), Rom.9:4, Jas.2:1 (see Hort, Mayor, in l.); hence of the manifested glory of God, Rom.1:23, Col.1:11 Eph.1:6, 12 17 3:16; of the same as communicated to man through Christ, 2Co.3:18 4:6; and of the glorious condition into which Christians shall enter hereafter, Rom.8:18, 21 9:23, 2Ti.2:10, al.
SYN.: ἔπαινος τιμή (see Hort on 1Pe.1:7). (AS)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: glory (as very apparent), in a wide application (literal or figurative, objective or subjective)

occurrences.bsb: Again, the devil took Him to a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
occurrences.kjv: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;

occurrences.bsb: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
occurrences.kjv: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

occurrences.kjv: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

occurrences.bsb: When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, He will sit on His glorious throne.
occurrences.kjv: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:

occurrences.bsb: If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will also be ashamed of him when He comes in His Father’s glory with the holy angels.”
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

occurrences.bsb: They answered, “Grant that one of us may sit at Your right hand and the other at Your left in Your glory.”
occurrences.kjv: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.

occurrences.bsb: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
occurrences.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

occurrences.bsb: Just then an angel of the Lord stood before them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
occurrences.kjv: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

occurrences.bsb: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to men on whom His favor rests!”
occurrences.kjv: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

occurrences.bsb: a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and for glory to Your people Israel.”
occurrences.kjv: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

occurrences.bsb: “I will give You authority over all these kingdoms and all their glory,” he said. “For it has been relinquished to me, and I can give it to anyone I wish.
occurrences.kjv: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when He comes in His glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.
occurrences.kjv: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father’s, and of the holy angels.

occurrences.bsb: They appeared in glory and spoke about His departure, which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
occurrences.kjv: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.

occurrences.bsb: Meanwhile Peter and his companions were overcome by sleep, but when they awoke, they saw Jesus’ glory and the two men standing with Him.
occurrences.kjv: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.

occurrences.kjv: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

occurrences.bsb: But when you are invited, go and sit in the last place, so that your host will come and tell you, ‘Friend, move up to a better place.’ Then you will be honored in front of everyone at the table with you.
occurrences.kjv: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.

occurrences.bsb: Was no one found except this foreigner to return and give glory to God?”
occurrences.kjv: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.

occurrences.bsb: “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

occurrences.bsb: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
occurrences.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

occurrences.bsb: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and then to enter His glory?”
occurrences.kjv: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?

occurrences.bsb: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us. We have seen His glory, the glory of the one and only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
occurrences.kjv: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus performed this, the first of His signs, at Cana in Galilee. He thus revealed His glory, and His disciples believed in Him.
occurrences.kjv: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

occurrences.bsb: I do not accept glory from men,
occurrences.kjv: I receive not honour from men.

occurrences.bsb: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another, yet do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
occurrences.kjv: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?

occurrences.bsb: He who speaks on his own authority seeks his own glory, but He who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is a man of truth; in Him there is no falsehood.
occurrences.kjv: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

occurrences.bsb: I do not seek My own glory. There is One who seeks it, and He is the Judge.
occurrences.kjv: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “If I glorify Myself, My glory means nothing. The One who glorifies Me is My Father, of whom you say, ‘He is our God.’
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

occurrences.bsb: So a second time they called for the man who had been blind and said, “Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner.”
occurrences.kjv: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

occurrences.bsb: When Jesus heard this, He said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.”
occurrences.kjv: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

occurrences.bsb: Isaiah said these things because he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about Him.
occurrences.kjv: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.

occurrences.bsb: For they loved praise from men more than praise from God.
occurrences.kjv: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

occurrences.bsb: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.
occurrences.kjv: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

occurrences.bsb: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—
occurrences.kjv: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

occurrences.bsb: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
occurrences.kjv: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

occurrences.bsb: And Stephen declared: “Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
occurrences.kjv: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,

occurrences.bsb: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked intently into heaven and saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
occurrences.kjv: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

occurrences.bsb: Immediately, because Herod did not give glory to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.
occurrences.kjv: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.

occurrences.bsb: Because the brilliance of the light had blinded me, my companions led me by the hand into Damascus.
occurrences.kjv: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.

occurrences.bsb: and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images of mortal man and birds and animals and reptiles.
occurrences.kjv: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

occurrences.bsb: To those who by perseverance in doing good seek glory, honor, and immortality, He will give eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:

occurrences.bsb: but glory, honor, and peace for everyone who does good, first for the Jew, then for the Greek.
occurrences.kjv: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:

occurrences.bsb: However, if my falsehood accentuates God’s truthfulness, to the increase of His glory, why am I still condemned as a sinner?
occurrences.kjv: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

occurrences.bsb: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
occurrences.kjv: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

occurrences.bsb: Yet he did not waver through disbelief in the promise of God, but was strengthened in his faith and gave glory to God,
occurrences.kjv: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;

occurrences.bsb: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we stand. And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.
occurrences.kjv: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

occurrences.bsb: We were therefore buried with Him through baptism into death, in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, we too may walk in newness of life.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

occurrences.kjv: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

occurrences.bsb: that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of the children of God.
occurrences.kjv: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

occurrences.bsb: the people of Israel. Theirs is the adoption as sons; theirs the divine glory and the covenants; theirs the giving of the law, the temple worship, and the promises.
occurrences.kjv: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;

occurrences.bsb: What if He did this to make the riches of His glory known to the vessels of His mercy, whom He prepared in advance for glory—
occurrences.kjv: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,

occurrences.bsb: For from Him and through Him and to Him are all things. To Him be the glory forever! Amen.
occurrences.kjv: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you, in order to bring glory to God.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.

occurrences.bsb: No, we speak of the mysterious and hidden wisdom of God, which He destined for our glory before time began.
occurrences.kjv: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery, even the hidden wisdom, which God ordained before the world unto our glory:

occurrences.bsb: None of the rulers of this age understood it. For if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
occurrences.kjv: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

occurrences.bsb: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all to the glory of God.
occurrences.kjv: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.

occurrences.bsb: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but the woman is the glory of man.
occurrences.kjv: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.

occurrences.bsb: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.
occurrences.kjv: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.

occurrences.bsb: There are also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. But the splendor of the heavenly bodies is of one degree, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is of another.
occurrences.kjv: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.

occurrences.bsb: The sun has one degree of splendor, the moon another, and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.
occurrences.kjv: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.

occurrences.bsb: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
occurrences.kjv: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:

occurrences.bsb: For all the promises of God are “Yes” in Christ. And so through Him, our “Amen” is spoken to the glory of God.
occurrences.kjv: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.

occurrences.bsb: Now if the ministry of death, which was engraved in letters on stone, came with such glory that the Israelites could not gaze at the face of Moses because of its fleeting glory,
occurrences.kjv: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:

occurrences.bsb: will not the ministry of the Spirit be even more glorious?
occurrences.kjv: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?

occurrences.bsb: For if the ministry of condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry of righteousness!
occurrences.kjv: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, what was once glorious has no glory now in comparison to the glory that surpasses it.
occurrences.kjv: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.

occurrences.bsb: For if what was fading away came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which endures!
occurrences.kjv: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.

occurrences.bsb: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into His image with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
occurrences.kjv: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.

occurrences.bsb: For God, who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” made His light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: All this is for your benefit, so that the grace that is extending to more and more people may cause thanksgiving to overflow, to the glory of God.
occurrences.kjv: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.

occurrences.bsb: For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal weight of glory that is far beyond comparison.
occurrences.kjv: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

occurrences.bsb: through glory and dishonor, slander and praise; viewed as imposters, yet genuine;
occurrences.kjv: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;

occurrences.bsb: More than that, this brother was chosen by the churches to accompany us with the gracious offering we administer to honor the Lord Himself and to show our eagerness to help.
occurrences.kjv: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:

occurrences.kjv: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: to the praise of His glorious grace, which He has freely given us in the Beloved One.
occurrences.kjv: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.

occurrences.bsb: in order that we, who were the first to hope in Christ, would be for the praise of His glory.
occurrences.kjv: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.

occurrences.bsb: who is the pledge of our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God’s possession, to the praise of His glory.
occurrences.kjv: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

occurrences.bsb: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.

occurrences.bsb: I ask that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of His calling, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints,
occurrences.kjv: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

occurrences.kjv: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

occurrences.bsb: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,
occurrences.kjv: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

occurrences.bsb: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
occurrences.kjv: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

occurrences.bsb: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
occurrences.kjv: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

occurrences.bsb: Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and their glory is in their shame. Their minds are set on earthly things.

occurrences.bsb: who, by the power that enables Him to subject all things to Himself, will transform our lowly bodies to be like His glorious body.
occurrences.kjv: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.

occurrences.bsb: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: being strengthened with all power according to His glorious might so that you may have full endurance and patience, and joyfully

occurrences.kjv: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

occurrences.kjv: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.

occurrences.bsb: For this reason I endure all things for the sake of the elect, so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

occurrences.bsb: And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

occurrences.bsb: The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of His nature, upholding all things by His powerful word. After He had provided purification for sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
occurrences.kjv: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

occurrences.bsb: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor
occurrences.kjv: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:

occurrences.bsb: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because He suffered death, so that by the grace of God He might taste death for everyone.
occurrences.kjv: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.

occurrences.bsb: In bringing many sons to glory, it was fitting for God, for whom and through whom all things exist, to make the author of their salvation perfect through suffering.
occurrences.kjv: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

occurrences.bsb: For Jesus has been counted worthy of greater glory than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.
occurrences.kjv: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.

occurrences.bsb: Above the ark were the cherubim of glory, overshadowing the mercy seat. But we cannot discuss these things in detail now.
occurrences.kjv: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.

occurrences.bsb: equip you with every good thing to do His will. And may He accomplish in us what is pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: My brothers, as you hold out your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, do not show favoritism.
occurrences.kjv: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.

occurrences.bsb: so that the proven character of your faith—more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:

occurrences.bsb: trying to determine the time and setting to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.
occurrences.kjv: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.

occurrences.bsb: Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and glorified Him; and so your faith and hope are in God.
occurrences.kjv: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.

occurrences.bsb: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,
occurrences.kjv: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:

occurrences.bsb: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of His glory.
occurrences.kjv: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

occurrences.bsb: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
occurrences.kjv: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

occurrences.bsb: As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:
occurrences.kjv: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

occurrences.bsb: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.
occurrences.kjv: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.

occurrences.bsb: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
occurrences.kjv: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

occurrences.bsb: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.
occurrences.kjv: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

occurrences.bsb: For He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory, saying, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
occurrences.kjv: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

occurrences.bsb: Such punishment is specially reserved for those who indulge the corrupt desires of the flesh and despise authority. Bold and self-willed, they are unafraid to slander glorious beings.
occurrences.kjv: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.

occurrences.bsb: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: Yet in the same way these dreamers defile their bodies, reject authority, and slander glorious beings.
occurrences.kjv: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.

occurrences.bsb: Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy—
occurrences.kjv: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,

occurrences.bsb: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: who has made us to be a kingdom, priests to His God and Father—to Him be the glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
occurrences.kjv: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: And whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One seated on the throne, who lives forever and ever,
occurrences.kjv: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,

occurrences.bsb: “Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and were created.”
occurrences.kjv: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.

occurrences.bsb: In a loud voice they were saying: “Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!”
occurrences.kjv: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

occurrences.bsb: And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying: “To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!”
occurrences.kjv: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.

occurrences.bsb: saying, “Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand were killed in the quake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
occurrences.kjv: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

occurrences.bsb: And he said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come. Worship the One who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and the springs of waters.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.

occurrences.bsb: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power; and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
occurrences.kjv: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: And the people were scorched by intense heat, and they cursed the name of God, who had authority over these plagues. Yet they did not repent and give Him glory.
occurrences.kjv: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.

occurrences.bsb: After this I saw another angel descending from heaven with great authority, and the earth was illuminated by his glory.
occurrences.kjv: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.

occurrences.bsb: After this I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting: “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!
occurrences.kjv: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:

occurrences.bsb: Let us rejoice and be glad and give Him the glory. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready.
occurrences.kjv: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.

occurrences.bsb: shining with the glory of God. Its radiance was like a most precious jewel, like a jasper, as clear as crystal.
occurrences.kjv: Having the glory of God: and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

occurrences.bsb: And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, because the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp.
occurrences.kjv: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.

occurrences.bsb: By its light the nations will walk, and into it the kings of the earth will bring their glory.
occurrences.kjv: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.

occurrences.bsb: And into the city will be brought the glory and honor of the nations.
occurrences.kjv: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
